name: nursery-management
description: Production-ready Nursery Management System: public website, admin dashboard, parent and staff portals, NestJS API, Kafka event-driven processing, PostgreSQL, Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nursery/shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w web
